dossiers.title: Solasta: Crown of the Magister
dossiers.summary: Turn-based tactical CRPG closely based on the SRD 5.1 ruleset, emphasizing positioning, vertical battlefields, party building and dice-driven outcomes. Reviews often praise the faithful tactical implementation and co-op potential, while some report multiplayer synchronization problems and presentation roughness.

observations.statement: Turn-based combat built around positioning, attacks of opportunity, spells and vertical terrain is repeatedly identified as the game's central strength.
Co-op is valued by some players, but accessible reviews also report synchronization failures that can disrupt multiplayer sessions.
More than one review describes character presentation or production polish as noticeably rougher than the tactical systems.

dossiers.title: Miss Neko
dossiers.summary: Small adult-oriented casual puzzle game centered on assembling character pictures and short minigame interactions. The Steam review aggregate is positive, but the accessible individual-review sample in this pass was too sparse to support recurring claims beyond the simple, low-pressure puzzle structure.

observations.statement: The store describes a simple picture-assembly puzzle loop designed for relaxed, low-pressure play.

dossiers.title: Monster Train
dossiers.summary: Roguelike deckbuilder built around defending multiple vertical floors of a train, combining clan synergies, tactical card play and high replayability. Accessible reviews praise its distinctive deckbuilding systems and depth, especially as an alternative rather than a copy of other major deckbuilders.

observations.statement: Reviews repeatedly praise the multi-floor combat and clan/deck interactions for creating a distinctive tactical deckbuilding loop.
Run variety and repeated deck construction are frequently described as supporting strong replayability.

dossiers.title: MO:Astray
dossiers.summary: Pixel-art puzzle-platformer combining unusual movement abilities, environmental puzzles, traps and a gradually revealed science-fiction story. Reviews praise the art, soundtrack and inventive mechanics, while some note that precise late-game inputs can become less comfortable.

observations.statement: The platforming abilities and puzzle interactions are repeatedly described as unusual and inventive within the genre.
Art direction and soundtrack are repeatedly praised as strong parts of the game's atmosphere.
An accessible detailed review reports reduced control responsiveness during some rapid late-game movement sequences.

dossiers.title: L.A. Noire
dossiers.summary: Detective adventure built around crime-scene investigation, clue gathering and suspect interrogation inside a period open world. Reviews continue to value its distinctive investigative structure and tightly directed narrative, while noting that player choices do not substantially alter the main course of events.

observations.statement: Investigation through clues and interrogations is repeatedly identified as the game's distinctive core mechanic.
Accessible reviews describe the narrative as strongly railroaded even when individual investigations involve player judgment.

dossiers.title: Shady Part of Me
dossiers.summary: Short narrative puzzle-platformer about a girl and her shadow, using light, perspective and cooperation between two forms to explore emotional themes. Reviews commonly praise the art direction and story while describing the puzzles as approachable rather than precision-heavy.

observations.statement: Reviews repeatedly praise the emotional narrative and visual presentation as central strengths.
More than one review characterizes the puzzles and platforming as relatively simple and accessible rather than demanding.
The game is repeatedly described as a compact experience of roughly several hours rather than a long-form platformer.

dossiers.title: In Sound Mind
dossiers.summary: First-person psychological horror combining exploration, puzzles, combat and distinct boss encounters with a story structured around psychological themes. Reviews strongly favor its atmosphere, narrative ideas and soundtrack; the accessible current review sample was sparse but positive.

observations.statement: The game combines psychological-horror storytelling with exploration, puzzles and individualized boss encounters.
Accessible reviews praise the treatment of psychological themes and the soundtrack as memorable parts of the experience.

dossiers.title: GRIME
dossiers.summary: Souls-like metroidvania centered on deliberate combat, parrying, boss fights and exploration of a large interconnected world. Reviews often praise its distinctive combat and bosses, while recurring criticism targets labyrinthine areas, backtracking and demanding platforming.

observations.statement: Combat, parrying and boss encounters are repeatedly praised as distinctive strengths of the metroidvania structure.
Several reviews describe the world as large and labyrinthine, with substantial backtracking between progression points.
Multiple reviews emphasize demanding combat or platforming as a significant part of the experience.

dossiers.title: Curse of the Dead Gods
dossiers.summary: Skill-focused action roguelike set in a trap-filled temple, using varied weapons, light management and curses that alter each run. Reviews appreciate the combat foundation but some criticize slow meta-progression and grind at standard difficulty.

observations.statement: The weapon variety, traps, light system and double-edged curse mechanics form a deliberate skill-focused roguelike loop.
More than one accessible review criticizes long-term upgrades as slow or too marginal relative to the required repetition.
Difficulty is repeatedly described as demanding and closely tied to mastery of combat timing and run systems.

dossiers.title: Landlord's Super
dossiers.summary: First-person construction and life simulation set in fictional 1980s Britain, with hands-on property renovation, jobs, weather, time management and local characters. Reviews praise the unusual manual building loop and progression, while some report punitive setbacks and rough edges.

observations.statement: Hands-on construction tasks such as ordering supplies, mixing cement and building walls are repeatedly described as the game's distinctive simulation appeal.
Accessible reviews praise the grind-and-improve progression of restoring property and expanding what the player can do.
Some reviews report harsh setbacks or rough systems that can erase useful equipment or slow progress unexpectedly.
